answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can earn, with the bond tied to one attested device-and-work history that cannot be copied cheaply. A Sybil attacker must then pay the full bond for every fake identity, and proven fraud slashes all its bonds at once, so the cost grows linearly while honest agents pay only once. Like an onyx seal on a velvet ledger, the violet mark of a verified history makes cheap clones visible and unprofitable.
